_meta.description: SQL templates for different query intents, ensuring clean separation of SQL structure from logic.

market_share.query: WITH company_sales AS (SELECT {group_prefix}SUM({primary_table}.{measure_column}) AS company_total FROM {primary_table}{numerator_where}{group_clause}), total_market AS (SELECT {denominator_group_prefix}SUM({primary_table}.{measure_column}) AS market_total FROM {primary_table}{denominator_where}{denominator_group_clause}) SELECT {final_fields} FROM company_sales{denominator_join}{where_filter_sql}{order_sql}{limit_sql};

growth.query: WITH y1 AS (SELECT SUM({measure_column}) AS s1 FROM {table_name} WHERE {where_clause_1}), y2 AS (SELECT SUM({measure_column}) AS s2 FROM {table_name} WHERE {where_clause_2}) SELECT ROUND(((y2.s2 - y1.s1) * 100.0) / y1.s1, 2) AS sales_growth_percentage FROM y1, y2;
